लप् लपति 1.
a. To speak. With अप
to deny; with आ^1 to address; with प्र^2 to
talk incoherently; with प्रति^3 to gain;
with वि^4 to lament; with सं to converse;
with वि^5 and with प्र^6 to contradict, dispute.

लाप्य (प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
a. That may be said
or spoken.
